scope: Bounded, source-informed next-point priorities for five catalog specs. These are heuristics inside a selected full target, not replacement imports or measured SBA-optimal leveling paths.
priorityMeaning: Higher integers come first among eligible target talents or selected prerequisite paths. All numeric ordering is inference from guide mechanics; the source does not publish this complete point-by-point order.
applicationRules: Match the current talent definition spellID and the selected import's entry/rank. Ignore every record absent from that target.
Resolve prerequisites, spend gates, level restrictions, active hero subtree, tree currency and already granted ranks through current game APIs.
Do not replace a target choice or activate another hero subtree to satisfy a priority. Hero passives compete only when their currency is available.
Apex records identify their first definition; later Apex entries use different spellIDs and follow the live rank sequence.
Retain manual cooldown and defensive talents if selected; SBA cannot replace the player's decisions about their use.
Unweighted target talents remain legal fallback. An unlisted talent is not a recommendation to omit it.
limitations: Definition IDs were retrieved from Icy Veins' live Midnight calculator JSON version 44 on the checked date; that schema exposes no exact game build number.

Havoc and Devourer match explicitly designated SBA catalog targets. The three Druid import pairs remain legacy-unverified; these weights do not establish their provenance, hero trees or patch validity.
Content-specific benefit is constrained by selected-target membership. Scores are not universal comparisons across specs.
No import was decoded using an assumed mapping, no live character was tested, and no SBA simulation was run.
